# The full re-run: §9.3, §10.2, §14.2, §14.3 and §14.4

§32.9's one open command. §14.2: the tables are "generated by the economy model under 5.8's rules — one producer of each kind per realm, pro-rata staffing, a crew assigned rather than timed — and replaced whole, never patched cell by cell", and "the full re-run publishes every milestone twice, at the bottom and the top of that band". This page is that run. A cell reads *Day a–b* across §9.6's attempt band (0.1222 to 0.1698), or one day where both edges agree.

## What the run sets first

§9.5 fixes the order: the raid base, then the sinks, then the birth rate.

| Value | Ships | The run | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B(V) base (9.6) | 2,400 | 2,400 | smallest hundred passing the raid-worth check on the day each Vault level arrives is 2,300, and the base only rises; on every day at a level it is 3,200 (F36) |
| Roster's keep (9.5) | 25% | 25% | ships at a quarter until the sink search sets it (T2.5) |
| Birth rate (9.5) | 1.3265 | 1.3488 | the rate at which an engaged player's 38th birth lands on the day every building tops out, at the band's lower edge; 1.3504 at its upper |

## The Codex (§14.4)

| Codex | Engaged | Never raids |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The full 48, 1,200 pages | day 95–97 | never (F37) |
| The launch 24, 510 pages | day 29 | never (F37) |

§14.4's arithmetic gives about 69 and 195 days for the full Codex, 30 and 80 for the launch set. The engaged player's pages match §14.4's rates — about 16 a day over the first 60 days and 23 after — but the last chapter opens at Keeper level 24 (7.6), so the full Codex lands on the day that level does, not the day the pages are there.

## What the run does not carry

- tier II and III laws (they compete with restoring for pages and need Aether)
- the main Sage's levels (Insight, 11.7)
- guards on posts (each is a worker less, 5.8)
- worker bonuses (+15% school, +25% trait, 9.2)
- Aether upkeep, which gates nothing the model buys
- raids against the player, and the experience a foiled one might pay
- pages for meeting a law and for Lab experiments that find nothing (7.6)
- 27.3's catch-up discount

Each would move a day, and none is guessed into the tables.

Reproduce: `python3 -m tools.economy_model rerun`; the tables are `tools/economy_model/rerun.py` under `Config.document()`.
